newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights end up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights end up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended up on Monday because of tight liquidity and dealers said they were likely to remain firm on Tuesday.
"Initially bids and offers were made at 19.90 and 20 percent, but rates later slipped to 19.50 percent," a dealer said. "By midday they had bounced back on a shortage of funds to 20 percent."
One-week borrowers were unable to cover their positions at around 16 percent, while two-week bids and offers remained mismatched at 15 and 18 percent, dealers said.
